battle.name: 爪哇戰爭
battle.brief: 1825 年 7 月 21 日，日惹王子蒂博尼哥羅在塞拉容洞起兵，圍攻日惹，荷屬東印度公司援軍 9 月 25 日解圍，直至 1830 年 3 月 28 日他在麥格朗被誘捕。卡面輪發手槍象徵公司軍官與近衛才配得上的昂貴副武器：荷軍步槍已換成燧發式，土軍仍以火繩槍與竹槍為主。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 爪哇戰爭（1825 至 1830 年）的主戰場在爪哇島中部的日惹與三寶崗之間，東端延到馬都加與爪哇東岸。荷方是荷屬東印度的殖民政府及其軍隊：總督府聽到起義消息後，把遠征蘇拉威西的部隊召回爪哇，指派亨德里克·梅爾庫斯·德科克為中部兩州的高等專員，自 1825 年 7 月 26 日起同時掌握日惹與三寶崗兩州的政治與軍事大權；荷蘭本土另派來約三千一百五十四名歐洲兵，戰事中再徵本地輔助兵逾一萬人，輔助兵多來自馬都加、北蘇拉威西與哥倫打洛、布通、馬魯古等地，另有巴厘王國派來一千名傭兵。兩個爪哇王國本身各有立場：日惹蘇丹國的蘇丹哈孟庫布沃諾五世年紀極輕，監護之一正是起義首領蒂博尼哥羅；三寶崗蘇南帕庫布沃諾六世態度曖昧，朝廷分成親荷與親叛兩派；芒庫內加拉二世與帕庫阿拉曼一世則明確親荷，芒庫內加拉軍團是荷方在中部最得力的本地打擊力量。叛方是蒂博尼哥羅率領的爪哇貴族與鄉村聯軍，仿奧斯曼禁軍的基幹編制，設十六名貴族統軍、每鎮名額千人並轄戶約萬，另設六個王宮近衛單位，本人親率三百至四百名騎兵護衛，另有宗教階層與地方官員加入。
countriesEn: The main theatre of the Java War (1825 to 1830) lay between Yogyakarta and Surakarta in central Java, with the eastern end reaching Madura and the east coast of the island. The Dutch side was the colonial government of the Dutch East Indies together with its army: after news of the rising the Governor-General recalled troops that had been sent on an expedition to Sulawesi and appointed Hendrik Merkus de Kock as commissioner to the two central princely states, from 26 July 1825 holding both civil and military authority over Yogyakarta and Surakarta; the Netherlands sent about three thousand one hundred and fifty-four European soldiers, and more than ten thousand native auxiliaries were recruited during the fighting, mostly from Madura, northern Sulawesi and Gorontalo, Buton and the Moluccas, while the Balinese kingdoms supplied a thousand mercenaries. The two Javanese states took different positions: the Sultan Hamengkubuwono V of Yogyakarta was still a child, and one of his guardians was the rebel leader Diponegoro himself; Sunan Pakubuwono VI of Surakarta was ambiguous, his court splitting between Dutch and rebel sympathisers; Mangkunegara II and Paku Alam I were openly pro-Dutch, and the Mangkunegaran Legion was the most reliable native striking force the Dutch had in the interior. The rebel side was the coalition of Javanese nobility and village levies led by Diponegoro, organised on an Ottoman janissary model: sixteen commanders of noble birth, each with a nominal force of a thousand men and about ten thousand households, six units of royal guards, a personal cavalry escort of three to four hundred men, and the addition of religious orders and local officials.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩條線。荷方：駐紮官 A. H. 斯米薩特自 1823 年起坐鎮日惹，1824 年廢除地租後索取高額賠償，1825 年又未與監護人協商便以租借名義併吞領地，把蒂博尼哥羅一步步逼到牆角；德科克接手後軍事手段與懷柔並用，1829 年 6 月發動總攻，1830 年 3 月 28 日在麥格朗的駐紮官邸誘捕蒂博尼哥羅；新任總督約翰內斯·范登博斯則奉威廉一世明確指示，不許與蒂博尼哥羅達成任何協議，只可殺或擒。爪哇王宮方面：蒂博尼哥羅（1785 年生，哈孟庫布沃諾三世長子）自述 1805 年南巡時受卡利查加與羅羅基杜爾女神顯靈指引，認定爪哇將有浩劫；他的精神顧問是宗教領袖克亞·馬惹，軍事指揮長期由森托特·普勞伊羅迪約擔任，其叔父賈亞庫蘇馬亦在軍中。各地起義分支各有首領：北岸三寶瓊一帶是塞蘭王子與其母阿根女將（Nyi Ageng Serang）率領的騎兵隊，東岸藍本（Rembang）是薩斯拉迪拉加，爪哇中部牙威（Ngawi）與馬迪翁（Madiun）是拉德·阿尤·尤達庫蘇馬，其中尤達庫蘇馬以「聰明但令人畏懼」聞名。叛軍內部的動搖同樣關鍵：兩名統將在 1827 年 7 月倒向荷方，森托特於 1829 年 10 月投降，克亞·馬惹在 1828 年 11 月遭伏被俘。
peopleEn: The decisive figures belong to two chains. On the Dutch side the official A. H. Smissaert had been resident at Yogyakarta since 1823; after abolishing the land rent he demanded heavy indemnities, and in 1825 he annexed territory as a lease without consulting the guardians, pushing Diponegoro step by step into a corner. De Kock took over and combined military pressure with negotiation, launching the general offensive in June 1829 and, on 28 March 1830, announcing the arrest of Diponegoro at the Resident's house at Magelang. The new Governor-General Johannes van den Bosch carried explicit instructions from King William I that Diponegoro was to be killed or captured and that no agreement was to be entered into. In the Javanese palaces: Diponegoro, born in 1785 as the eldest son of Hamengkubuwono III, wrote that in 1805 on his pilgrimage to the south coast he received visions from Sunan Kalijaga and the goddess Roro Kidul and was warned of the ruin of Java; his spiritual adviser was the religious leader Kyai Maja, while military command long remained with Sentot Prawirodirdjo, son of the rebel Rongga Prawiradirja, and his uncle Prince Jayakusuma served in the army. The regional branches had their own leaders: on the north coast near Semarang, Prince Serang with his mother Nyi Ageng Serang commanding a cavalry unit; at Rembang on the east coast, Raden Aria Sasradilaga; and around Ngawi and Madiun, Raden Ayu Yudakusuma, whom the Dutch described as a clever but much dreaded woman. Defections inside the rebel command mattered just as much: two of Diponegoro's commanders went over to the Dutch in July 1827, Sentot surrendered in October 1829, and Kyai Maja was ambushed and taken in November 1828.
kits: 卡面這件輪發手槍是十六世紀初流傳於德意志與西班牙一帶的後膛手槍，機械發條昂貴，只配給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。爪哇戰爭爆發時，荷屬東印度的軍官副武器早已改為燧發手槍，輪發手槍只以舊式樣殘件留在日惹與三寶崗的王宮兵器庫以及爪哇禁衛手中，作為儀仗與近衛的舊制武器；卡面之器在此標示的，正是「昂貴個人副武器只屬軍官與近衛」這條規律的起點，而它在 1825 年早已不是野戰裝備。真正決定戰局的火器有四類：荷軍正規步兵裝燧發滑膛步槍，以火藥配紙包或布包定裝藥，配刺刀；芒庫內加拉軍團同樣以燧發步槍為幹，並配少量燧發手槍；本地輔助兵與爪哇王宮部隊則常用火繩槍（matchlock arquebus）與長矛；叛軍火器極缺，以竹矛、鐮刀與獵槍為主，但大量使用繳獲的荷軍燧發步槍與火繩槍，並在日惹與麥格朗一帶繳獲荷軍野戰砲與火藥。荷軍有火炮、帳幕與沿海船運的補給線，叛軍有三百至四百名騎兵，並就地取材製作竹柵、削尖竹樁與竹製拒馬等障礙器材；雙方都自行配製彈藥，叛軍自熬火藥、分裝散藥，荷軍的定裝藥則由本土船運供應。
kitsEn: The wheellock pistol on the card is a breech-loading handgun that circulated in Germany and Spain from the early sixteenth century. Its spring mechanism was expensive, so it was issued only to officers of the musket line and to the guards. By the time the Java War broke out, the officer sidearm of the Dutch East Indies had long since become the flintlock pistol, and the wheellock survived only as an old-pattern relic in the armories of the Yogyakarta and Surakarta palaces and in the hands of the Javanese court guards, serving as a ceremonial piece and as the badge of an older guard establishment. What the card marks is the beginning of the rule that an expensive personal sidearm belongs to officers and guards alone, and in 1825 it was no longer a field weapon. Four classes of firearm actually decided the fighting. VOC regular infantry carried flintlock smoothbore muskets, with paper or cloth cartridges and bayonets; the Mangkunegaran Legion was built on the same flintlock musket and had a few flintlock pistols; native auxiliaries and the Javanese princely troops relied on matchlock arquebuses and long spears; and the rebels were short of arms, fighting with bamboo spears, krises and hunting guns, while making heavy use of captured Dutch flintlock muskets and matchlocks and seizing Dutch field guns and powder at Yogyakarta and in the Magelang area. The Dutch had artillery, tents and a supply line carried by coastal shipping; the rebels had three to four hundred cavalrymen and improvised obstacles from local materials, bamboo screens, sharpened stakes and bamboo cheval-de-frise; both sides prepared their own ammunition, the rebels boiling their own gunpowder and filling loose cartridges, while the Dutch cartridges came by sea from the homeland.
tactics: 開戰初期是攻守對峙。蒂博尼哥羅在塞拉容洞集結，荷軍一支前往日惹集結的縱隊在途中遭突襲而覆沒，荷軍隨後對山洞的強攻因叛軍已撤而落空；叛軍轉而圍困日惹，圍城自 7 月底延續到 9 月 25 日，荷軍以七千五百人的解圍部隊驅散攻城者。1826 年 10 月 15 日，叛軍在三寶崗以西的加沃克被德科克擊敗，人數優勢當場瓦解，戰爭整體轉為遊擊。爪哇中部多水田、灌叢與密集村落，叛軍極善用地形：埋伏於道路旁草叢以火槍手狙擊荷軍縱隊，騎兵以竹柵偽裝隱蔽接近，農民手持農具參戰並切斷退路，又在道路上設置伐倒的樹木與削尖的竹樁。荷軍則自 1827 年起推行「堡壘體系」（Benteng-stelsel），沿補給線大量修築稜堡，把叛軍擠壓在普羅戈河與波戈文托河之間的三角地帶，1828 至 1829 年修堡最為密集，叛軍據點被逐個拔除，縱隊只要離開稜堡的火力圈就會遭伏擊。德科克同時在格羅戈蘭辦起軍官學校，訓練本地出身的基層軍官，用以逐步替換忠誠度不可靠的徵召兵，荷軍的縱隊編制、行軍縱深與火力掩體因此日益接近歐洲近代軍制。
tacticsEn: The opening phase was a contest of siege and relief. Diponegoro mustered at Selarong, a Dutch column on its way to assemble at Yogyakarta was destroyed in an ambush on the road, and a Dutch assault on the cave failed because the rebels had already withdrawn. The rebels then invested Yogyakarta, and the siege ran from late July to 25 September, when a relief force of seven thousand five hundred men drove the besiegers off. On 15 October 1826 the rebels were defeated at Gawok west of Surakarta, their numerical advantage shattered at a stroke, and the war as a whole turned into a guerrilla campaign. Central Java is a landscape of wet rice, scrub and dense villages, and the rebels used it expertly: they lay up in the grass verges beside the roads and sniped at Dutch columns with muskets, screened their cavalry with bamboo fences, fought alongside the peasants who came armed with farming tools to cut off the line of retreat, and blocked the roads with felled trees and sharpened bamboo stakes. From 1827 the Dutch pursued the fortress system (Benteng-stelsel), building strong redoubts in large numbers along the supply routes and squeezing the rebels into the triangle between the Progo and the Bogowonto; the building of forts was densest in 1828 and 1829, rebel strongpoints were picked off one by one, and any column that stepped beyond the guns of the forts was ambushed. De Kock at the same time opened a cadet school at Grogolan to train junior officers of native birth, so as gradually to replace recruits whose loyalty could not be trusted; the Dutch columns, their order of march, their depth and their use of cover grew steadily closer to the European system.
data: 可核對的數字以兵力為主。荷方在印尼的總兵力約一萬二千五百人，其中約半數為本地徵召兵；另有本土派來的歐洲兵三千一百五十四人，戰事中再徵本地輔助兵逾一萬人。1825 年 9 月 25 日解圍日惹的援軍為七千五百人。到 1827 年 4 月，德科克麾下已有一千六百人陣亡，殖民當局隨即削減開支，輔助兵徵募受到限制。1828 年荷方在冊本地輔助兵約九千人，其中芒庫內加拉軍團佔二千五百人；同年外地輔助兵來自爪哇與馬都加略逾五千人、北蘇拉威西與哥倫打洛約一千三百人、布通七百人、馬魯古八百五十人，另有巴厘傭兵一千人。叛軍方面，起義之初有約七十名王族帶著武裝侍從加入蒂博尼哥羅；編制上十六名統將各轄名額千人與戶約萬，另有六個近衛單位，貼身騎兵三百至四百人；塞蘭王子一支部隊初有八千人；加沃克敗後仍聚約五千人，至 1829 年 9 月退入普羅戈河谷時只剩三百人，1830 年 3 月 28 日被誘捕時護衛約一百人且正在晨操。荷方代價：荷軍與本地兵合計約一萬五千人陣亡，其中荷籍約八千人、本地輔助兵約七千人；三千一百五十四人的遠征部隊到 1830 年已有約三分之二死傷耗盡。戰爭的財政開支估計為二千萬至二千五百萬荷蘭盾。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are mainly those of military strength. The Dutch command in the Indies numbered about twelve thousand five hundred men, roughly half of them native recruits, and there were in addition the three thousand one hundred and fifty-four European soldiers sent from the Netherlands and more than ten thousand native auxiliaries recruited during the war. The relief force that lifted the siege of Yogyakarta on 25 September 1825 numbered seven thousand five hundred men. By April 1827 one thousand six hundred of de Kock's men had been killed, and the colonial government responded by cutting expenditure, which limited further recruitment of auxiliaries. In 1828 the Dutch native auxiliaries on their rolls numbered about nine thousand, of whom two thousand five hundred served in the Mangkunegaran Legion; that year auxiliaries came from Java and Madura in slightly over five thousand men, from northern Sulawesi and Gorontalo about one thousand three hundred, from Buton seven hundred and from the Moluccas eight hundred and fifty, with a further thousand Balinese mercenaries. On the rebel side, about seventy members of the royal family joined Diponegoro at the outset with their armed retinues; the organisation gave sixteen commanders a nominal thousand men and ten thousand households each, plus six units of royal guards and a personal cavalry of three to four hundred men; the force under Prince Serang numbered eight thousand at the beginning; after the defeat at Gawok some five thousand men were still gathered together; by September 1829, confined to the Progo valley, only three hundred remained; and at his arrest on 28 March 1830 Diponegoro had about a hundred escorts, who were away on morning drill. The Dutch cost: about fifteen thousand military dead, roughly eight thousand Dutchmen and seven thousand native auxiliaries, and of the three thousand one hundred and fifty-four strong expeditionary force about two thirds had died or been spent by 1830. The financial cost of the war was estimated at twenty to twenty-five million guilders.
cause: 起因可分三層。最遠的一層是 1755 年吉延提條約把馬塔蘭蘇丹國分成日惹蘇丹國與三寶崗蘇丹國，1757 年再分出芒庫內加拉，爪哇王公在法屬與英屬時期實力反而增長。1806 年總督達恩德爾斯推行集權，1811 至 1816 年英軍佔領爪哇，1812 年英軍攻入日惹王宮、廢黜哈孟庫布沃諾二世並另立幼主，削弱王公勢力的同時也留下對荷蘭的深刻怨恨。1816 年荷蘭恢復統治後，駐紮官制度、賠償要求、地租的廢除與新稅制的引入，逐步抽空王室的財政基礎。中層是宗教與末世情緒：1821 年霍亂流行、1822 年默拉皮火山噴發，鄉村間流傳爪哇將遭浩劫的預言，蒂博尼哥羅自稱頻頻得到顯靈，認定必須以聖戰驅逐荷蘭人並自任爪哇的伊斯蘭領袖。最直接的一層是 1825 年的導火線：6 月 17 日斯米薩特下令修築一條穿越蒂博尼哥羅田莊德加雷惹的公路，工人與其部眾屢起衝突，7 月 20 日荷方派兵企圖逮捕他，7 月 21 日他宣布起兵，退入塞拉容洞，隨後號召各地王族與鄉村起而響應。
causeEn: The causes fall into three layers. The most distant is the Treaty of Giyanti of 1755, which divided the Mataram Sultanate between the Yogyakarta Sultanate and the Surakarta Sunanate, with Mangkunegaran split off in 1757; the Javanese princes had actually grown stronger during the French and British years. In 1806 Governor-General Daendels imposed centralisation, and between 1811 and 1816 British troops occupied Java, storming the Yogyakarta keraton in 1812, deposing Hamengkubuwono II and setting a child on the throne; in weakening the princes they left behind a deep grievance against the Dutch. After Dutch rule was restored in 1816 the residency system, the demand for indemnities, the abolition of the land rent and the introduction of a new tax system slowly drained the finances of the court. The middle layer is religious and millenarian: the cholera epidemic of 1821 and the eruption of Merapi in 1822 spread through the countryside a conviction that Java was to be ruined, and Diponegoro claimed that visions came to him repeatedly, that he must drive the Dutch out by holy war and become the Muslim leader of Java. The most immediate layer is the spark of 1825: on 17 June Smissaert ordered a road to be built or repaired across the Tegalreja estate of Diponegoro, the workers and his men collided repeatedly, on 20 July the Dutch sent troops to arrest him, and on 21 July he declared his rebellion, withdrew into the cave at Selarong and called on the princes and villages of the interior to rise.
impact: 這場戰爭改變了荷屬東印度的統治方式，也重塑了爪哇的政治結構。兩州王公在戰後被大幅削權：日惹蘇丹國的版圖縮到今日日惹特別區的大小，三寶崗蘇南帕庫布沃諾六世於 1830 年被廢黜並流放安汶，芒庫內加拉因助荷有功獲頒威廉軍事勳章並接管更多土地，帕庫阿拉曼的效忠同樣換來特權。殖民地財政隨即由范登博斯在 1830 年推行的種植制度接上，強制耕作把出口作物推上爪哇土地，據估算在制度廢除前為荷蘭國庫帶來逾八億盾收入，這筆錢正是荷軍得以重建的原因之一。戰術層面的教訓更為直接：荷方在爪哇飽受持久戰與遊擊之苦，此後在蘇門答臘、婆羅洲等戰役改用海岸轟擊與大規模登陸的震懾手段；同時因懷疑本地兵的忠誠，殖民軍開始大量招募非洲士兵，印尼人稱之為「黑荷蘭人」。被俘的蒂博尼哥羅先流放萬雅老，1833 年轉入更堅固的望加錫堡，1849 年起被限制在堡內，1855 年 1 月 8 日去世，其後裔在 1950 年之前不得進入日惹王宮。爪哇此後再無大規模武裝抗爭，直到二十世紀四十年代的印尼獨立革命；而蒂博尼哥羅的形象則成為反殖民抵抗的象徵，被後世的文學與繪畫反覆引用。
impactEn: The war changed how the Dutch East Indies was governed and reshaped Javanese politics. The princely states were stripped of power afterwards: the Yogyakarta Sultanate shrank to roughly the extent of today's Special Region of Yogyakarta, Sunan Pakubuwono VI of Surakarta was deposed and exiled to Ambon in 1830, Mangkunegaran was awarded the Military Order of William for its service to the Dutch and took over further territory, and the loyalty of Paku Alam was likewise rewarded with privilege. The colonial finances were then handed over to the Cultivation System introduced by Van den Bosch in 1830, which pushed export crops onto Javanese land by forced cultivation; it was estimated to bring the Dutch treasury more than eight hundred million guilders before its abolition, and that money was among the things that made the rebuilding of the colonial army possible. The tactical lesson was even more direct: having been worn down by a war of attrition and guerrilla in Java, the Dutch turned in later campaigns in Sumatra and Borneo to a strategy of coastal bombardment and large-scale landings intended to break any will to resist; and because they doubted the loyalty of native troops, the colonial army began recruiting Africans in large numbers, whom the Indonesians called the Black Dutchmen. The captured Diponegoro was first exiled to Manado and in 1833 transferred to the stronger fortress of Makassar, where from 1849 he was confined within Fort Rotterdam; he died there on 8 January 1855, and his descendants were barred from the Yogyakarta keraton until 1950. No large-scale armed resistance would take place in Java again until the Indonesian National Revolution of the 1940s, while the figure of Diponegoro became the emblem of anti-colonial resistance, quoted again and again by later literature and painting.
result: 結果是荷方全面勝利，但勝利來自五年的消耗而非一場決戰。1828 年 11 月克亞·馬惹遭伏被俘，1829 年 6 月荷軍發動總攻，9 月 17 日蒂博尼哥羅在普羅戈河谷的西盧克村被擊潰，眾多統將陣亡，10 月森托特投降，叛軍主力散作小股游擊隊，其控制區被壓縮到日惹以西。1830 年 3 月 28 日，蒂博尼哥羅帶著約一百名護衛前往麥格朗的荷蘭駐紮官邸會談，被德科克當場宣佈逮捕；護衛當時正在晨操而被解除武裝，蒂博尼哥羅當日被押往三寶瓊，隨即流放。其後日惹方面仍有零星抗爭，至 1831 年方告完全收束。戰役的實際終局是：爪哇兩州再無獨立的軍力與外交權，荷蘭在島上取得不受質疑的統治，爪哇自此統一歸入東印度的行政與財政體系；而蒂博尼哥羅的名字則成為反殖民抵抗的象徵，由後世反覆引用。
resultEn: The result was an outright Dutch victory, but a victory won by five years of attrition rather than by a single decisive battle. Kyai Maja was ambushed and taken in November 1828; the Dutch launched their general offensive in June 1829; on 17 September Diponegoro was beaten at the village of Siluk in the Progo valley, many of his commanders were killed, and in October Sentot surrendered while the main body of the rebel army fell apart into small guerrilla bands, its area of control compressed to the west of Yogyakarta. On 28 March 1830 Diponegoro went with about a hundred escorts to the Dutch Resident's house at Magelang and was there announced as arrested by de Kock; the escorts were out on morning drill at the moment and were disarmed peacefully, and Diponegoro was taken the same day to Semarang and thereupon exiled. Isolated resistance in the Yogyakarta area continued for a time afterwards, and only in 1831 was the matter wholly wound up. The practical end of the campaign was this: the two princely states retained no independent armed force or diplomatic power of their own, the Dutch obtained undisputed rule over the island, and Java was drawn into the administrative and financial system of the East Indies as a single unit; while the name of Diponegoro became the emblem of anti-colonial resistance, quoted again and again by later generations.
